name: Horadori Chikara
source:
Name: Chikara Horadori
Sex: Male
Age: 60
Birthday: March 28
Profession: Director of Horadori Institute of Genetics
Likes: Deoxyribonucleic Acid, Simulation Theory, % 
Dislikes: Death
Hobbies: Research, Experiments, Collecting Hats
Skills: Using Electric Drills

A brilliant scientist who established the Horadori Institute of Genetics at a young age. The institute mainly researches DNA treatment and gene therapy. He divorced his wife 6 years ago. His ex-wife and daughter now live in Italy.

[From the in-game character description]

[spoiler]Formerly a member of Naixatloz, he had an affair with [url=/c108944]Tokiko Shigure[/url] and is the father of [url=/c110381]Jin Furue[/url]. He kidnapped [url=/c112135]Uru Somezuki[/url] to cure Jin's illness. His cruel research into genetics —reaching for immortality— created the [url=/c112133]original Mizuki[/url], her [url=/c101029]clone[/url], and [url=/c108946]Gen[/url]. He also managed to slow down [url=/c108949]Shoma[/url]'s aging and growth.
Chikara is the second victim of the HB Case in the Past, 6 Years Ago.[/spoiler]
